title: Comprehensive 5-Session Implementation Plan
synthesized_from: TT1-EXECUTION-PLAN (step-by-step workflows, agent prompts, contingency plans)
TT2-TECH-ARCHITECTURE (tool specs, MCP configs, data pipelines, integration matrix)
TT3-QUALITY-RISK-PLAN (quality framework, risk registry, anti-recursion enforcement, success metrics)

executive_summary.goal: Produce 15-27 market research picks across 5 sessions, breaking the zero-output streak that has persisted for 14+ team sessions
executive_summary.approach: Progressive capability building: Session 1 uses only WebSearch (zero dependencies), Sessions 2-3 add financial data tools, Session 4 cleans debt, Session 5 packages everything as reusable skill
executive_summary.key_insight: The system is READY. The blocker is behavioral (infrastructure recursion), not technical. All needed base tools exist.
executive_summary.critical_constraint: Session 1 MUST produce picks with ZERO infrastructure work. Non-negotiable.
executive_summary.team_pattern: 5 agents per session (SOP-022 SIZE-03), 60%+ domain work (SOP-023 AR-01)

sessions.title: Market Research Sprint: First Picks

roles.tasks: Enforce zero-infra rule. Time-box. Quality-gate picks.
Macro backdrop, sector screening, stock screening with fundamental.md
News sentiment, insider transactions, analyst ratings using sentiment.md
Merge scores, rank candidates, set prices, multi-method validation
Create pick files, update index, create KB entry, write session log

sessions.workflow_summary: Macro backdrop (10min) → Sector screening (10min) → Stock screening (15min) → Fundamental + Sentiment analysis (25min) → Composite scoring + selection (10min) → Pick file creation (15min) → Documentation (15min)
sessions.tools_NOT_needed: All methods are documented in market-research/methods/. TEMPLATE.md is ready. Zero new tools required.
quality_gates_from_tt3: Every pick passes >= 8/10 items on pick quality checklist
Valuation: P/E compared to sector median
Risk: >= 2 specific risks identified, stop-loss price set
Data freshness: financial data no older than 5 trading days

risk_mitigations_from_tt3.RISK-001_recursion: CRITICAL: Coordinator blocks ANY infrastructure proposal. If 30 min pass with no candidates, pick obvious large-caps.
risk_mitigations_from_tt3.RISK-002_zero_output: Time-box sector screening to 10 min. Reduce scope to 1-2 picks if needed. Better 1 adequate pick than 0 perfect.
risk_mitigations_from_tt3.RISK-003_quality: Apply 10-point checklist. Cross-reference data from 2+ sources.

success_criteria.nice_to_have: 5 picks, 200+ word macro backdrop, 1 domain KB entry

roles.tasks: Verify MCP servers before research starts. Quality-gate picks.
Install 3 MCP servers + build pick_logger.py. Time-box: 45 min max.
Use new MCP tools for deeper analysis. Apply fundamental.md + technical.md.
Update macro backdrop, fresh sentiment data, validate Session 1 picks.
Log picks via pick_logger, create KB on MCP evaluation, write session log.

mcp_servers.name: yahoo-finance
mcp_servers.fallback: pip install mcp-yahoo-finance; pip install yahoo-finance-mcp

mcp_servers.name: edgartools
mcp_servers.impact: If works, Session 3 coding agent builds method_fred.py instead

pick_logger.cli: argparse with subcommands (create, update, list, performance)
pick_logger.key_feature: Atomic file writes (write to .tmp then rename)

decision_point_from_tt2.question: Does EdgarTools MCP work?
decision_point_from_tt2.test: pip install edgartools && python3 -c "from edgar import Company; c = Company('AAPL'); print(c.get_filings(form='10-K').latest())"
decision_point_from_tt2.if_yes: Skip method_sec_edgar.py in Session 3, build method_fred.py instead
decision_point_from_tt2.if_no: Build method_sec_edgar.py in Session 3 as planned

risk_mitigations_from_tt3.RISK-006_rate_limits: Yahoo Finance (no limits) is primary for screening. Alpha Vantage reserved for deep analysis only.
risk_mitigations_from_tt3.RISK-008_mcp_fails: Time-box 15 min per server. Fall back to WebSearch (proven in Session 1).

success_criteria.must_have: >= 1 MCP server working, pick_logger.py functional, >= 3 new picks, Session 1 picks validated
success_criteria.failure: 0 MCP servers AND 0 picks, OR pick_logger non-functional

sessions.title: SEC EDGAR Integration + Sector Deep Dive

roles.tasks: Select target sector based on Sessions 1-2. Resolve DECISION-01.
Build method_sec_edgar.py (if EdgarTools failed) OR method_fred.py (if EdgarTools works).
Comprehensive analysis of 5-8 companies in target sector.
Update macro, compare sectors, validate prior picks.
Create picks, sector analysis KB entry, session log.

success_criteria.must_have: New tool functional, sector analysis with 5+ companies, >= 3 picks, cumulative >= 9 picks

roles.tasks: Partition fixes vs domain. Enforce no scope expansion on infra.
Fix 7 items from Gamma audit. Time-box: 80 min total.
Current prices, calculate returns, check stops/targets.
Material changes, sentiment shifts, hold/sell/add recommendations.
Update picks, portfolio KB entry, validate indexes, session log.

risk_mitigations_from_tt3.RISK-010_scope_creep: Limit to exactly 7 items. Coordinator halts expansion. Remaining bugs go to deferred backlog.
risk_mitigations_from_tt3.RISK-014_regressions: Write test BEFORE fix. Run full test suite after each fix. Follow SOP-020.

success_criteria.must_have: 5+ of 7 hygiene items done, 2 critical TOCTOU fixed with tests, all picks have performance data
success_criteria.failure: < 5 items done OR portfolio review not performed

roles.tasks: Review Session 5 Agent Skill. Draft Sessions 6-10 roadmap.
Build method_fred.py (if not done) + package Agent Skill.
FRED/BLS data for macro analysis. Investment themes.
Multi-method picks using all tools. Macro-aligned.
Economic KB, 5-session retrospective KB, picks, session log.

agent_skill_spec_from_tt2.name: market-research
agent_skill_spec_from_tt2.content: 7-step workflow: (1) Macro backdrop via method_fred.py, (2) Sector screening via WebSearch + Yahoo Finance, (3) Stock screening with quantitative filters, (4) Deep analysis with fundamental+technical+sentiment checklists, (5) Cross-validation with 2+ methods, (6) Pick logging via pick_logger.py, (7) Documentation

success_criteria.must_have: FRED tool functional, Agent Skill packaged, economic report, >= 3 picks, retrospective, next roadmap draft
success_criteria.failure: FRED non-functional AND 0 picks, OR no retrospective

integration_matrix_from_tt2.data_flow: WebSearch/MCP → Analysis Checklists → Composite Scoring → pick_logger.py → Pick Files + Index → Performance Tracking
integration_matrix_from_tt2.session_dependency_chain: S1 (proven workflow) → S2 (MCP + pick_logger) → S3 (SEC EDGAR + sector depth) → S4 (data hygiene + portfolio review) → S5 (FRED + Skill + retrospective)

critical_risks: RISK-001: Infrastructure recursion trap (HIGH likelihood, HIGH impact) — enforce SOP-023 at every session
RISK-002: Session 1 zero output (MEDIUM likelihood, HIGH impact) — zero prerequisites, time-box everything
high_risks: RISK-003: Poor pick quality (MEDIUM, HIGH) — 10-point checklist, 2+ sources
RISK-004: TOCTOU data loss (MEDIUM, HIGH) — avoid affected patterns until Session 4 fix
anti_recursion_red_flags: Agent proposes building a tool in Session 1
30 min with no domain artifact in progress
Discussion of deferred items before Session 5

session_quality_scorecard_from_tt3.grading: A >= 90, B 75-89, C 60-74, D 40-59, F < 40. D/F triggers mandatory retrospective.

next_steps: Session 1 can launch immediately. Zero prerequisites. All tools exist (WebSearch, WebFetch). Methods documented. TEMPLATE.md ready. The only thing needed is execution.
